neighbours.label: the sentence-initial word 'Because' or 'Since' opening a reason clause, up to its subject and verb (Because public support is key, Since this lesson needs)
fire: Because farmers need water, the dam was built.
Since this method has few steps, children like it.
Because the bridge is old, trucks avoid it.
Since these tools have sharp edges, keep them locked.
Because of the storm, the match was cancelled.
Since that road has many curves, drive slowly.
Because nurses are scarce, wards are closing.
Since this film has subtitles, anyone can watch.
quiet: Farmers need water, and the dam was built.
This method has few steps, and children like it.
The bridge is old, and trucks avoid it.
These tools have sharp edges, and we keep them locked.
During the storm, the match was cancelled.
That road has many curves, and drivers go slowly.
Nurses are scarce, and wards are closing.
This film has subtitles, and anyone can watch.

notes: Second round. The first round placed the clause after an earlier sentence, and it narrowly failed on the median (0.191; AUROC 1.000). New probes as the first sentence of a text: 'Because' 0.311 in three frames, ' this' after 'Since' 0.338; the same content without the opener under 0.01. This round tests a text-initial reason clause; note that AGENTS.md warns sentence-initial tokens score differently, so this is a claim about that position.
